summary: Iteration 24 — Financeit-style program catalog backend + frontend test. 17/17 pytest pass (programs auto-seed of 16 system defaults, std_60_240 quote math $175.63/$13,888.28 balloon, buy-down 7.99 savings vs base, promo_12 zero-interest $1000/mo, defer_6 accrual vs defer_6_int_free, inline-program quote w/o persistence, CRUD with soft-disable on system defaults, min $4500 enforced, public submit accepts new SIN/address/home_ownership/employer/project fields, AI pitch returns 3 variations w/ family-pizza comparison for $210, from-job stores program_id). Frontend verified: 16 program cards, 5 filter chips, edit modal live preview updates instantly on APR/dealer-fee change, Calculator modal has Program dropdown + full breakdown, JobDetail Finance button respects $4500 threshold (visible at $5000, hidden at $1000).
critical_code_review_comments: fresh_cash_service.program_quote() returns 'balloon_payment' (not 'balloon') — review_request docs used 'balloon' shorthand but actual field is balloon_payment; UI (FinancingPrograms.jsx live preview) correctly uses quote.balloon_payment. Consistent across backend + frontend.

POST /api/financing/from-job response is flat (amount/application_id/public_token/sms_result) — not nested under 'application'. Frontend FinanceJobModal reads body.application_id/body.public_token directly so this is consistent; just documenting for future testers.

_seed_programs_for() inserts inside GET /api/financing/programs handler — pragmatic auto-seed but tenants with seeded data still pay an extra round-trip query per list call. Consider lazy seeding on first POST/PATCH or via startup hook + index lookup.
ApplicationCreateIn min-amount enforced via Field(gt=fc.MIN_AMOUNT - 0.01) → returns 422 (Pydantic). Review_request said 422 but actual contract is correct; test accepts both 400/422.

FinancingPrograms.jsx live-preview pane calls /api/financing/program-quote with inline 'program' dict on every form change — works smoothly with no debounce. For very fast typing this could fire 10+ requests; consider lodash.debounce(300ms) on the form watcher.
Soft-disable on system defaults is correct, but UX shows the program 'opacity-60' rather than visually clarifying 'system default — re-enable in Settings'. Minor polish.
All key UI elements have data-testid attributes (prog-card-*, prog-filter-*, prog-edit-*, prog-modal, prog-apr, prog-fee, prog-save, detail-finance-button) — excellent testability.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed jobs and one TEST_custom_xxx program (deleted at end of test). One promo_24 system program toggled (re-activated in teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_24_finance_programs.py — uses dotenv fallback so it can run via raw pytest CLI without REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Note: fresh_cash_service quote response uses 'balloon_payment' key (not 'balloon'). POST /api/financing/from-job response is FLAT, not nested under 'application'. POST /api/financing/applications min-amount enforced via Pydantic (422), error message threshold is fc.MIN_AMOUNT=4500. Public submit URL is /api/public/financing/{token}/submit.
